ficha_publicada.complicacoes: Star-Band Corruption: The Star-Band erodes Evil Star’s principles and sanity. He is vulnerable to remorse and guilt when faced directly with his past atrocities. Starlight: Being isolated from starlight reduces every power in the Star-Band by one rank per full day of isolation.
